components.name: ChatBubble
components.summary: One message in a chat: the AI assistant or Aleem at inline-start, the visitor at inline-end, and quiet system notes centred.

components.name: FeatureCard
components.summary: Benefit/feature card: icon tile, heading, copy, and capability tags.

components.name: StatCard
components.summary: Headline metric: Aleem leads with big numbers everywhere.

components.name: Testimonial
components.summary: Customer testimonial card: leads with a gradient result metric, then quote and attribution.

components.name: TypingIndicator
components.summary: Show between the visitor's message and the reply, so the pause reads as "thinking", never as "broken".

components.name: CoryMark
components.summary: The Cory mascot mark, kept for the admissions assistant case study.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: Rounded-tile avatar for people, the AI assistant, Aleem himself, and the admissions case-study mascot.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: Pill label for statuses and inline metrics, the chips that pepper Aleem's marketing and dashboards.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Pill-shaped CTA button, use for any primary or secondary action; one primary (brand gradient) per view.

components.name: Chip
components.summary: Selectable pill for filter bars, tag pickers, and toggles, the interactive counterpart to Badge.

components.name: IconButton
components.summary: Round icon-only button, close, menu, play, mute, theme toggle. label is required (it becomes the aria-label).

components.name: FeedbackIcon
components.summary: The shared tone glyph used by Alert, Toast and Dialog.

components.name: Alert
components.summary: Inline feedback banner for page- or section-level messages that stay until resolved (a Toast is for brief confirmations after an action).

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: Modal for a focused task (short form, confirmation) that must finish before the page continues.

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: Use this wherever a list, panel or search result has nothing to show.

components.name: Toast
components.summary: Brief confirmation after an action ("Saved", "Call booked", "Message sent"), gone in 6 seconds.

components.name: ToastRegion
components.summary: Hosts toasts in one live region so screen readers announce them.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: Names an icon-only control or clarifies a short label on hover and keyboard focus.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: Labelled checkbox for consent, multi-select lists, and bulk selection.

components.name: Input
components.summary: Labelled text field with soft rounding and a blue focus ring.

components.name: Select
components.summary: Dropdown for 5+ mutually exclusive options (institution type, role, time zone).

components.name: Toggle
components.summary: Switch for settings that take effect immediately (notifications, autoplay, dark theme in a settings page).

components.name: Icon
components.summary: Owned Aleem icon set: 24px grid, 1.75 stroke, round caps, 20% currentColor duotone tint.

components.name: Illustration
components.summary: Aleem spot illustrations: the solid mascot tile is the subject, props around it are duotone shapes from the icon set, a soft cyan glow sits behind.

components.name: ProgressBar
components.summary: Progress when it can be measured (uploads, imports, multi-step onboarding) or an indeterminate sweep for a page-level wait.

components.name: Skeleton
components.summary: The bones of a loading layout.

components.name: Spinner
components.summary: Activity indicator for one action or a small area where the layout is not known yet.

components.name: Card
components.summary: Blank surface tile.

components.name: DirectionToggle
components.summary: Reading-direction switch.

components.name: MediaFrame
components.summary: Image / video in a rounded, aspect-locked tile.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Tabs, segmented control, or filter bar, one component, animated indicator.

components.name: ThemeToggle
components.summary: Light and dark theme switch.

components.name: ConfidenceMeter
components.summary: How sure an AI result is: five pips plus words ("High confidence"), so it never relies on colour alone.

components.name: Citation
components.summary: Inline numbered marker that ties a claim to its source; links to it when there is a URL.

components.name: SourceList
components.summary: Numbered source tiles, used by AIResponse and available for custom layouts.

components.name: AIResponse
components.summary: One AI answer, designed to earn trust: it says it is AI, shows how sure it is, cites its sources inline and lists them, and lets people copy, rate or regenerat…

components.name: AgentSteps
components.summary: A live log of what an agent is doing, step by step, so people can follow the work and step in when it needs them.

components.name: ApprovalCard
components.summary: Human in the loop: an agent proposes an action and waits.

components.name: PromptInput
components.summary: The composer for talking to an AI: grows with the text, sends on Enter (Shift + Enter for a new line), offers starter suggestions, counts characters near the l…

components.name: ProjectCard
components.summary: A case study in the portfolio grid: cover, context line (client, role, year), title, one-line outcome, the proof metric and topic tags.

components.name: Timeline
components.summary: Experience or milestones, newest first: period, title, organisation, place, a summary and optional highlights.

components.name: Accordion
components.summary: Questions and answers, process details or long specs that most readers skip.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.summary: One choice from a short list (2 to 5 options), all visible at once.

components.name: Textarea
components.summary: Multi-line text for messages, briefs and feedback.

components.name: SkeletonPreset
components.summary: Ready-made skeletons with the same geometry as the real components, so the swap from loading to loaded never moves anything.

components.name: LoadingRegion
components.summary: Wrap any region that loads.

components.name: ErrorState
components.summary: A whole region that failed.

components.name: StateView
components.summary: One region, every state, one prop.

components.name: SiteHeader
components.summary: The top bar of a site: brand, primary links and one action.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.summary: Shows where a page sits, and lets people step back up.

components.name: Pagination
components.summary: Moves through pages of a list or table.

components.name: Table
components.summary: A data table with real table semantics.

components.name: SiteFooter
components.summary: The bottom of a site: who it is, where everything is, and the legal line.

components.name: Menu
components.summary: A dropdown of actions on one thing: the "More" on a card or table row.

components.name: Stepper
components.summary: Shows progress through a short, ordered flow of 2 to 6 steps: an enquiry form, onboarding, a booking.

components.name: DateField
components.summary: A date, or a date and time.

components.name: SignalPattern
components.summary: The brand's signature graphic: rows of pills, like tokens in a design system or words in an AI answer.

components.name: Hero
components.summary: The opening of a page: one idea, one gradient phrase, one primary action.

components.name: PortfolioHome
components.summary: A full portfolio home page built only from this system, to copy from and to prove the parts work together: SiteHeader, Hero (its art is a live AIResponse that…
